description: Welcome to 90 Laurel View Way  a beloved summer house cherished by three generations, now ready for your own memories. Ideally situated in the heart of old Inverness, this vintage gem blends privacy with convenience.  The main house offers three bedrooms, two baths, and a warm living room with original redwood walls and a wood-burning stove. Outside, a brick-paved terrace sets the scene for morning coffee, sunbathing, or alfresco dining amid serene surroundings.  A detached guest house with its own bath and kitchenette provides flexible space for extended family, guests, or a private home office. Nearby footpaths connect you effortlessly to Inverness's charming neighborhoods.  More than a property, 90 Laurel View Way is a place full of history, warmth, and character  a rare opportunity to own a piece of Inverness charm.
